content: NubeSDK storefront apps historically supported ONLY on Patagonia theme per official ui-slots doc ('Storefront apps built with NubeSDK are supported only when the store is using the Patagonia theme. For all other themes, you must use the legacy storefront app model.'). However an active Nuvemshop rollout is expanding NubeSDK to all themes; opt-in via a Google Form ('[NubeSDK] Solicitação de teste') grants SDK activation within 1 business day for a specific test store. This is an unresolved, time-sensitive conflict that Phase 1 must resolve empirically for the Talgui store's actual active theme.
